class.name: Terrain
class.brief_description: Displays a heightmap terrain mesh using multiple levels of details (LODs).
class.description: The terrain is displayed using a single multi-mesh using the CDLOD technique that relies on the GPU to render the shape of the terrain and process the seams between different LODs.

members.member: Scale of the map in the different directions.
The map storage resource that will stream the terrain data.
